title: Read File Line By Line
description: Read a text file line by line using getline
explanation: Reads a file line by line. The loop ends when getline fails (EOF or error).

title: Write To File
description: Write text to a file using ofstream
explanation: Writes formatted text to a file using the stream operator.

title: Read Binary File
description: Read a binary file using read()
explanation: Binary files are read as raw bytes using read().

title: Write Binary File
explanation: Binary writes use write() with a char pointer and size.

title: File Open Modes
explanation: Combine flags with | to get the desired file access mode.

title: Check File State Flags
description: Check file stream state (good, fail, eof, bad)
explanation: Stream state flags help diagnose I/O errors.

title: String Stream
description: Use stringstream for in-memory string parsing
explanation: stringstream provides stream operations on strings for parsing and formatting.

title: File Seek Tell
description: Random access in files with seekg, seekp, tellg, tellp
explanation: seekg/tellg are for input streams; seekp/tellp for output streams.

title: Check If File Exists C++17
description: Check if a file exists using std::filesystem (C++17)
explanation: std::filesystem::exists provides a portable way to check file existence.

title: CSV File Parsing
explanation: Simple CSV parsing using getline with comma delimiter. Production use should handle quoted fields.
